title: Settings
hint: Changes apply immediately and stay on this device. Account settings follow you.

language.title: Language
language.hint: Pack text stays in its own language until a translation pack is installed.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.hint-tavern: Dark oak, candlelight, parchment and brass. The default.
appearance.hint-scroll: A vellum desk by daylight: the same leaves and brass, ink text.
appearance.hint-plain: High contrast, flat, no textures or tilt. Easiest on weak devices.
appearance.density-hint: Compact rows are 28 px, comfortable 36 px; picker cards grow with it. Buttons stay the same size.
appearance.motion-hint: Damage shake, seal spend, level-up flourish, the candle flicker. Off also when your system asks for reduced motion.

storage.title: Storage
storage.persist-note: Asks the browser never to evict Herokeep's data when space runs low. Once granted, it stays.
storage.persist-tip: Ask the browser to keep this device's data
storage.granted-tip: The browser will not evict Herokeep's data

cache.title: Campaign image cache
cache.hint: Portraits and tokens shared in campaigns are cached on this device up to this limit.

packs.title: Content packs
packs.core-tip: The rules pack built into the app
packs.count: {count, plural, one {# content pack installed} other {# content packs installed}}
packs.updates: {count, plural, one {# update ready} other {# updates ready}}
packs.updates-tip: Heroes adopt a newer pack version from their Build tab
packs.import-invalid: This pack could not be imported
packs.translations-load-failed: Saved packs could not be loaded — continuing without them

account.title: Account
account.prompt: Sign in to sync your heroes across devices and join campaigns from any of them. Accounts need no e-mail; keep your recovery codes.
account.state-anon-tip: Not signed in; heroes stay on this device only
account.summary: {heroes, plural, one {# hero syncs} other {# heroes sync}} to this account from {devices, plural, one {# device} other {# devices}}.
account.no-email: There is no e-mail: recovery codes are the only way back in.
account.local-note: Heroes always stay on this device.
account.logout-hint: Signs this device out; heroes stay on it
account.logout-all-hint: Ends every session of your account, including this one; asks to confirm

logoutAllConfirm.title: Log out everywhere?
logoutAllConfirm.body: This ends every signed-in session for your account, including this one.

devices.title: Devices
devices.revoke-hint: The device is signed out at once

revokeConfirm.title: Revoke "{deviceLabel}"?
revokeConfirm.body: That device will be signed out immediately.

toast.revoke-failed: Couldn't revoke that device. Try again.

devices.revoke-self: This is the device you are using; use Log out instead
devices.revoke-unknown: This older session cannot be revoked on its own; use Log out everywhere

quota.title: Account storage
quota.total: {used} of {max} · {heroes, plural, one {# hero} other {# heroes}}
quota.hint: Each hero may use up to {max}; portraits count.

export.success: {count, plural, one {# hero exported.} other {# heroes exported.}}
export.failure: Couldn't export the heroes. Try again.
export.pack-assets-missing: The pack {pack} was not included: some of its images are missing on this device.

about.title: About & licences
about.open5e-credit: Structured SRD data derived from the Open5e project (https://open5e.com).
about.icons-credit: Icons made by {authors}. Available on https://game-icons.net (CC BY 3.0).
about.fonts-credit: Forum (Denis Masharov) and Alegreya (Huerta Tipográfica), SIL Open Font License.
about.release-notes-reason: Release notes arrive with the first public release

help.title: About these settings
help.appearance: Theme, density, motion and language apply at once and are remembered on this device only.
help.storage: Heroes live on this device. Keeping the data protects it from the browser clearing space; the image cache only holds pictures shared in campaigns.
help.account: An account is optional. It syncs heroes between your devices; there is no e-mail, so keep the recovery codes shown when you create it.
